verdict.rationale: The pack never mentions dev/staging/prod environments, per-environment flag states, or environment-scoped SDK keys. The closest item, target apps (statsig-docs-41), scopes gates to applications within a project, which is a different axis and says nothing about keys. Gate overrides apply to specific users, not environments. This is a fair axis for a feature-flag platform, so the lack of evidence yields "none" rather than "na".
